club.name: Hitchin Running Club
club.tagline: A friendly, all-pace running club based in Hitchin. Three sessions a week, every distance from first 5K to marathon PB, and a club that turns up for each other — rain, shine, or thick winter fog.

sessions.title: Intervals
sessions.description: Speedwork at the track or around town.
sessions.meet: New location weekly (check Facebook/Spond for confirmation)

sessions.title: Beginners & Club Run
sessions.description: In summer this heads out into local countryside, in winter it stays around town. We aim to cover around 10km as a club run.  Let us know via Facebook or Spond before turning up

sessions.title: Club Run
sessions.description: Typically cross country with a 10km distance as the target.

membership.description: Membership includes various running events, mid-week leagues, and a number of non-running socials each year such as a summer BBQ and Christmas do.
membership.note: Sign up via Facebook to say hello, then come along to your first session at St Mary's car park.

joinSteps.title: Sign up via Facebook
joinSteps.description: Our Facebook page is the best place to say hello and ask any questions before your first run.

joinSteps.title: Come along to your first session
joinSteps.description: Join us at St Mary's car park, Wednesday or Sunday. No minimum pace, no pressure.

joinSteps.title: Join the club on Spond
joinSteps.description: Once you're part of the club, Spond is how we publish running events and gather feedback.

videos.title: The Hitchin Monopoly Run
videos.description: Roll the dice, run the streets — highlights from our board-game-inspired club night.

videos.title: Timed Relays
videos.description: Fast legs, faster changeovers. Add your relay reel link here once you've got the embed URL.

eventBoxes.title: Mid-Week League
eventBoxes.description: Our summer mid-week league sees us line up against neighbouring clubs across Hertfordshire — all paces welcome, from front-runners to first-timers.

eventBoxes.title: Chip Shop Challenge
eventBoxes.description: A club favourite — run to the chip shop, eat your chips. Silly, sociable, and exactly the kind of thing the Hares do best.

eventBoxes.title: Monopoly Run
eventBoxes.description: Roll the dice and run the streets — our take on the classic board game turns Hitchin into a giant board with checkpoints and challenges along the way.

eventBoxes.title: Burnt Hare Events
eventBoxes.description: Our sister events site brings great races and trail runs to Hitchin and the surrounding Hertfordshire countryside throughout the year.

eventBoxes.title: Strava Club
eventBoxes.description: Log your runs, kudos your clubmates, and see how the group is getting on. Every session and Sunday long run ends up here.

eventBoxes.title: Spond
eventBoxes.description: Spond is where all our events are organised and discussed — RSVP to socials, races and league fixtures, and get reminders before they happen.

events.description: We run a number of events under the banner of Hitchin Hares, including competing in the Herts Winter Cross Country League and the Summer Mid-Week League. We're also linked with Burnt Hare, who bring great running events to Hitchin and the surrounding Hertfordshire countryside.

couchTo5k.title: Couch to 5K
couchTo5k.intro: A friendly 6-week programme for all abilities, led by a club coach. Small steps, big goals — finishing with a 5K run in week 6.

highlights.label: 6 weeks
highlights.text: Wednesday evenings with a 5K at the end

highlights.label: Medal + fizz
highlights.text: A medal and a glass of fizz at the finish

highlights.label: Support
highlights.text: Remote support and assignments between sessions

couchTo5k.note: Start dates and timings are posted on our Facebook page.
couchTo5k.imageAlt: Couch to 5K poster: a 6 week running programme for all abilities
